title: Rb1 exerts anti-inflammatory effects and suppresses BoHV-1 replication by activating Caspase-3 and regulating the NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Wei, Yiming; Wang, Xiaolin; Li, Keyan; Hao, Wen; Li, Jianming; Gong, Qinglong; Hu, Guixue; Wang, Kai; Leng, Xue; Du, Rui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究人参皂苷Rb1通过Caspase-3和NF-kappaB通路抗炎及抑制牛疱疹病毒复制，虽含分子对接但核心是病毒-宿主免疫调控，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Bovine herpesvirus type 1 (BoHV-1) is the pathogen causing infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR), which induces severe respiratory and reproductive system lesions in cattle, resulting in intense inflammation and significant economic losses. Ginsenoside Rb1, as the main active component of ginseng, has significant anti-inflammatory activity and shows potential in immune regulation. However, it remains unclear whether Rb1 is involved in regulating the mechanism of BoHV-1-mediated inflammatory response. Based on this, this study hypothesizes that Rb1 exerts immunomodulatory and other effects during infection, which will be verified through in vitro and in vivo experiments. METHODS: Therefore, this study employs network pharmacology and GO/KEGG enrichment analysis to screen and identify disease-related targets and physiological processes associated with ginseng's active components. Molecular docking and CCK-8 assays determine the affinity and mode of action between key ginseng compounds and their targets. To verify the regulatory effects of key active substances on immune-related processes in infected cells as well as bovine and rabbit animal models through in vitro and in vivo experiments. RESULTS: This study identified active components of ginseng and targets associated with BoHV-1; analyzed core targets and related pathways; observed strong affinity between Rb1 and core targets; clarified BoHV-1's regulatory effects on core targets such as Caspase-3; Rb1 suppresses the upregulation of inflammatory mediators mediated by NF-kappaB overexpression by promoting Caspase-3 activation during the inflammatory peak, and enhances apoptosis (about 70%) to reduce viral titers (about 1 time). The therapeutic effects of Rb1 were also validated in in vivo experiments. CONCLUSION: Collectively, these findings indicate that Rb1 plays a crucial role in regulating the inflammatory response and viral replication during BoHV-1 infection, suggesting that Rb1 may represent a novel therapeutic approach for clinical applications involving BoHV-1.
abstract_zh: 背景：牛疱疹病毒1型（BoHV-1）是引起牛传染性鼻气管炎（IBR）的病原体，可导致牛呼吸道和生殖系统严重病变，引发强烈炎症并造成重大经济损失。人参皂苷Rb1作为人参的主要活性成分，具有显著的抗炎活性，并在免疫调节方面显示出潜力。然而，Rb1是否参与调控BoHV-1介导的炎症反应机制尚不清楚。基于此，本研究假设Rb1在感染过程中发挥免疫调节等作用，并通过体外和体内实验加以验证。方法：因此，本研究采用网络药理学及GO/KEGG富集分析，筛选并鉴定与人参活性成分相关的疾病靶点和生理过程。分子对接和CCK-8实验确定人参关键化合物与其靶点之间的亲和力和作用方式。通过体外和体内实验，验证关键活性物质对感染细胞以及牛和兔动物模型中免疫相关过程的调节作用。结果：本研究鉴定了人参活性成分及与BoHV-1相关的靶点；分析了核心靶点及相关通路；观察到Rb1与核心靶点之间具有强亲和力；阐明了BoHV-1对Caspase-3等核心靶点的调节作用；Rb1通过促进Caspase-3激活，在炎症高峰期抑制NF-kappaB过表达介导的炎症介质上调，并增强细胞凋亡（约70%）以降低病毒滴度（约1倍）。Rb1的治疗效果也在体内实验中得到了验证。结论：综合这些发现表明，Rb1在BoHV-1感染期间调节炎症反应和病毒复制中发挥关键作用，提示Rb1可能代表一种针对BoHV-1相关临床应用的新型治疗策略。
